title: Filter views (All/Work Orders/Estimates/Completed) apply in every display
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Open the Work Orders page fresh (no prior tab chosen).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work Orders page.
  2. Read the filter tabs across the top.
  3. Note which tab is selected on arrival.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The filter views (the tabs on the left: All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) are shown to a user with Work Orders view permission and apply the same way in every display option (List, Tech View, Board View).
  • The filter bar (search, status, assigned to me, and so on) applies the same way in every display option.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options”, PRD v33 (2026-09-28), §2 Feature Overview (the filter views) — re-sourced 30 Sep 2026 after old S1-R5/S1-R10 were withdrawn as numbered requirements. Source-verified on 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • §2 Feature Overview: “The existing filter views (the tabs on the left — All, Work Orders, Estimates, Completed) and the filter bar (search, status, assigned to me, and so on) apply the same way in every display option.”
